item.title: Sr National Wrestling C'ship: Lalit, Sahil, Chetan, Sachin And Others Strike Gold In Greco-Roman Bouts
item.description: Senior National Wrestling Championship: Gold medals were shared among institutions and states on Day 3 of the 2025 Senior National Wrestling Championship in Ahmedabad, as all 10 Greco-Roman weight categories were decided, showcasing the strength of RSPB, SSCB, and Haryana.

item.title: Abhishek Reminds Me Of Jayasuriya, He Instils Intimidation And Fear In Bowlers: Uthappa
item.description: Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association: Former India cricketer Robin Uthappa reserved high praise for opener Abhishek Sharma, comparing the youngster to former Sri Lankan great Sanath Jayasuriya after his quick-fire knock set the tone for the team’s win against South Africa in the third T20I.

item.title: TPL: GS Delhi Aces Clinch Maiden Title As Season 7 Concludes In Ahmedabad
item.description: Gujarat University Tennis Stadium: GS Delhi Aces emerged victorious to clinch their maiden title in the Tennis Premier League (TPL) season 7, beating Yash Mumbai Eagles at the Gujarat University Tennis Stadium.

item.title: Gavaskar to Holden: Cricket’s Curious Case of Retired-Out and Strategic Batting
item.description: From Gavaskar’s cautious 1970 World Cup innings to Max Holden’s retired-out tactic in ILT20, cricket showcases the evolving strategies and psychology behind staying at the crease.

item.title: Suvendu Adhikari Seeks Impartial Probe Into Chaos At Messi Event In Kolkata
item.description: West Bengal Assembly Suvendu Adhikari: Leader of the Opposition in the West Bengal Assembly Suvendu Adhikari on Sunday sought an impartial probe into the chaos that erupted during Argentine football star Lionel Messi's event at the Yuva Bharati (Salt Lake) Stadium, alleging striking similarities between the handling of the incident and the investigation process in the RG Kar rape and murder case.

item.title: Ashes: Tongue Replaces Atkinson As England Name Starting XI For Adelaide Test
item.description: Wales Cricket Board: England have announced their playing XI for the upcoming third Test of the Ashes series, which begins on Wednesday at Adelaide Oval. Gus Atkinson has been replaced by Josh Tongue.

item.title: Rodrygo, Mbappe Earn Vital La Liga Win For Real Madrid
item.description: Goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois: Kylian Mbappe and Rodrygo scored to give Real Madrid a 2-1 win away to Alaves, trimming the gap to La Liga leader FC Barcelona to four points.

item.title: Steyn Calls For 'stability In Selection' After Proteas' Loss In 3rd T20I
item.description: Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association: Former South African pacer Dale Steyn expressed concerns over South Africa’s lack of consistency after the team’s seven-wicket defeat in the third T20I, saying the Proteas need "stability in selection" as frequent changes are "affecting the team's performance."

item.title: It'll Boost Popularity Of Squash Among Youth: PM Modi Congratulates Indian Team On Historic WC Win
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday congratulated the Indian team on winning the first-ever Squash World Cup, saying the victory will boost the sport's popularity among the youth.

item.title: Surya, Shubman Will Be Match-winners In World Cup: Abhishek Sharma
item.description: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari: India opener Abhishek Sharma has supported captain Suryakumar Yadav and vice-captain Shubman Gill to win matches for the team in the run-up to next year’s Men’s T20 World Cup, which will be held from February 7 to March 8 in India and Sri Lanka.
